text:
emily: Final runbook for 'Inference at Scale' launch webinar — Thurs 11am PT. Main asks: registration UX (personalized replay landing), Zoom fallback + OBS RTMP, recording + caption pipeline, dynamic CTAs in post-replay page, and HubSpot routing. Need quick owners.

noah: I can own the registration page + personalization tokens. Plan: collect 'primary_goal' (prototype/prod/migrate) and 'team_size' and use those to show 1 of 3 CTA variants on the replay page. Also add a hidden field utm_segment=launch_inference.

carlos: Zoom/ops here. I'll set cloud recording + OBS RTMP backup to rtmp://backup.redwood.com/launch-scale. Will also enable separate audio tracks and original sound. Question: do we want breakouts off? For a broadcast, yes.

leah: I'll own captions & transcript. Live: enable Zoom auto-cc for speed, then run our internal transcribe+align job to produce per-speaker SRT, web VTT, and chapter markers. Store under s3://redwood-marketing/launch-scale/{timestamp}/. Retain 90 days.

ben: I'm on HubSpot mapping and post-replay personalization. Mapping rules: primary_goal -> content_stream property; team_size bucket -> assign to AE if >50. For replay page personalization we'll pass contact email hash and tokens via signed query so we can render tailored CTA. Make sure we don't leak PII in public links.

ops-bot: deploy: rtmp_backup_rule created -> target: rtmp://backup.redwood.com/launch-scale, retention: 21d

emily: Personalization details: 3 CTAs = "Start free hosted trial" (prototype), "Schedule dedicated capacity consult" (prod), "Migration checklist" (migrate). Use server-side render on replay page if signed token present; fallback to generic CTA. @noah add sample signed token spec to the sheet.

noah: Will add spec. Signed token contains contact_id (hashed), exp, and segments. Link example will be tinyurl.com/scale-replay?tk=xxxx. Also will add opt-out param if user declined marketing.

carlos: Greenroom notes: audio check 10:30, slides in chat, disable waiting room for panelists, panelists added as cohosts: emily,noah,leah. OBS fallback will record to local drive and push to S3 as secondary copy via upload microservice.

leah: Transcribe job: after ops-bot uploads recording, async job tx-3571112500 will run -> outputs: full_txt, speaker_srt, chapter_json. I'll generate clipmarks for priority timestamps and tag language variants for social.

ben: HubSpot workflow: watched_replay boolean, personalized_cta string, clip_engagement_count int. Also create event 'replay_viewed' in Segment with properties {personalized_cta, time_watched, clips_clicked}. Webhook payload example in ops sheet.

ops-bot: upload: recording 3571112444 uploaded -> s3://redwood-marketing/launch-scale/recordings/3571112444.mp4

emily: Clip prioritization: 60s demo, 30s benchmark nugget, 15s ROI stat. Editors: leah will mark rough cuts; if fine polish needed, handoff to video contractor. Tag clips with segment=prototype/prod/migrate so we can mail the right clip to each segment.

noah: Replay page requirements: mobile-first, pre-roll 6s teaser if viewer from social, show dynamic CTA, caption toggle, download transcript button, and a "Request a 1:1" button that pre-fills contact info if token present. Also include a short FAQ pulled from live Qs.

carlos: Backup checklist: OBS RTMP to backup, local recording, cloud recording. If cloud fails, ops-bot will detect missing upload and trigger manual ingest. We'll keep a monitoring alert in #release-war-room.

leah: Post-event timeline: 0-2h -> transcript + captions + chapter markers + clip picks. 2-8h -> personalized replay page up for signed users, 24-48h -> localized social clips + 48h nurture email. Deliver assets to comms by +24h.

emily: Post-event emails: immediate thank-you + personalized CTA (owner: emily), 48h clip email segmented by primary_goal (owner: noah), 5d deeper technical deck for engaged viewers (owner: carlos). Sales follow-up for contacts with watched_replay=true and time_watched>600s.

ben: Privacy note: signed tokens must expire after 7 days and be single-use for security. Public replay link will be available after 24h with generic CTA. Confirm encryption for S3 objects.

ops-bot: transcribe: job tx-3571112500 started -> outputs: srt, plain_text, chapter_markers

noah: Small ask: include a short reg question "Which deployment are you evaluating?" with options Hosted/Dedicated/Private. This will help personalize CTA and routing.

emily: Great. Final: update the post-event triage sheet within 6 hours with clip owners, signed-token mapping, and HubSpot tags. I'll audit at 6pm PT. If blocked ping #marketing-ops and @emily. :rocket:
